name: web-coral-financial-dashboard-with-ask-anything-prompt-and-bento-widgets
title: Coral Financial Dashboard with Ask Prompt
whatItIs: A rounded pale dashboard with a header of logo, user and search, a date circle and a coral Show my Tasks button beside a large 'Hey, Need help? Just ask me anything!' prompt with a mic button, and a bento of cards: a Visa card, totals, a system lock, a growth ring, a stocks line, concentric circles of annual profit, an activity manager, a wallet verification card and a rating question.
whatItMeans: Coral on cream and white is warm and friendly for finance, and concentric circles make profit brackets visual.
techniques: Coral as the single accent on cream
Concentric circles as a profit chart
Big conversational prompt in the header
Mixed bento of small cards and rings
Emoji rating buttons drawn as simple faces

vocabulary.definition: A large question inviting the user to ask the assistant.
A dashboard built from tiles of different sizes.
